quests.title: Special Research: Melusine?

dialogue.t: Whoa! A real Melusine! Aww... such a tiny, adorable little Melusine...
Hmm? Who... who are you?
Umm... may I... touch you? I've always wondered what a Melusine like you feels like...
Something so cute and so clever... Are you smooth? Or soft? Or maybe fluffy? Hehe... don't be scared. I just want to give you a little...
Uh... Huh!?
Please mind your conduct, miss, and refrain from any actions that may violate the statutes.

Miss Mamere is a citizen of Fontaine. Unauthorized physical contact may lead to misunderstandings and could carry serious legal consequences, including imprisonment for over three years and permanent prohibition from entry.
Aaaah! A machine that moves and talks...!
Ahem... my apologies. She was just too adorable, and I got carried away...
My name's Linnea. I'm an advisor working for the Adventurers' Guild. Uh... And I promise I'm not a weirdo!
Negative. Individuals engaging in suspicious behavior often insist they are "not a weirdo." This is a basic principle of deductive reasoning, Miss Linnea.
Aah...!
You shouldn't just go around calling people weirdos, Seymour.
This small fairy lady has really pretty colors. She's not like Fa{RUBY#[D]Elynas}ther, but she feels warm and looks nice. That means she's not a weirdo.
Negative. With the exception of purple, coloration generally bears no relation to one's moral alignment. This is a basic principle of deductive reasoning, Miss Mamere.
...I wasn't talking about the color of people's clothes, Seymour.
Huh? Why is purple an exception?
Well... hello, Linnea. My name is Mamere. I'm a traveling painter from Fontaine. This is Seymour. He's a good friend of mine.
I didn't expect to meet anyone else here. Are you here to gather inspiration, too?
Gather inspiration... hmm, let me think. I suppose adding new entries to my archive counts, right?

dialogue.sit: Linnea tells Mamere about the pink Frostfin Whale...

dialogue.t: And, hehe... maybe Maisie was right after all. That Frostfin Whale really does bring good luck! I even got to meet an adorable Melusine—
Please mind your conduct, miss, and refrain from any actions that may violate the statutes.
I—I know! I won't touch anything without permission!
I see. Do you like animals, Linnea?
Absolutely! *sigh*... if only I could swim as fast as a Melusine... Those Frostfin Whales looked like they were having so much fun. I want to play with them too...
Hmm... then I'll give this painting to you, Linnea.
It can't help you swim faster, but if you hang it in your room... maybe it'll feel like you're playing with the Frostfin Whales.
Whoa... thank you! It's beautiful! When I get back, I'll show it to everyone in Speranza for sure!

quests.description: An extraordinary Melusine was spotted traveling with a mechanical dog…
